notes.title: New Dome Discover - map update and more...
notes.content:
Hello everybody!! . You may probably have noticed that we have been a bit away this week, and the reason has been that we have been working on the transcription of a part of the code of our new project. Since the Unreal code changes from 4.24 to version 4.26 and we want to get there with no problems. In order to achieve this we must work on optimizing and improving the project. I've also taken the audacity to change the map a little bit:

notes.title: Urgent update (V 0.2.0b).
notes.content:
We made a last minute change: we have modified and fixed a bug which made it impossible for the player to keep playing. When loading the map and selecting the M button it did not allow you to return to the current game.
We apologize for the inconveniences this may have caused.

notes.title: New update: 0.2.0 a
notes.content:
As we have already mentioned this will only be  bug fixes. 
The following changes were made to the game: 

[list]
[*] We made Slime more tame for the early part of the game.
[*] We have improved the help messages so that the player can be guided in a  better way.
[*] We implement button M to see the level map.
[*] We lowered the brightness of the level a bit. What do you think about it?
[*] Fixes of small bugs such as buttons that were stuck, no texts or annoying camera are seen in small insides.
[*] Change of  stones location.
[/list]

From now on we will dedicate ourselves to add more content to the game. Remember that you can see our weekly posts & updates on our social networks.

We thank all of you!!!

notes.title: And time has come.
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I am here to announce that the marketing and launch stage was a complete success. Well... a success for a person who has just started in this career, so it's time to time to roll up our sleeves and begin the new stage: fix bugs.


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] I have noticed my blunder: "not adding a combat tutorial". In future updates, Kyrie will help us
[*] (our teacher), and will take us through the teachings of the art of battle.
[*] The battle system seems to be my weakness, so I will focus on this.
[*] Improve the healing potions, notice that they loaded very little. So we will make them load more!
[*] We will improve the indoor camera. For sure we will fix it as it is very frustrating for the player.
[*] Improve the maps and quest guides.
[*] Improve the sales system
[*] Campfires to rest? It is a good idea, we will consider it
[*]Little bugs* as transfers of objects, we have already marked many.
[/list]

Thank you very much for your help. I really feel very alive, and I feel like I can start typing fiercely. There is still too much to improve!

PS: there will be an upcoming surprise. I hope you like it.
